主要内容: On May 16, 2012, DISH DBS Corporation, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of DISH Network Corporation, entered into an indenture relating to the issuance of $900,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.625% Senior Notes due 2017 at an issue price of 100%. The Company also entered into an indenture relating to the issuance of $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 5.875% Senior Notes due 2022 at an issue price of 100%. Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, as trustee, was involved in both indentures. DISH Network CORP issued Notes in a private placement, complying with Regulation S and Rule 144A. The 2017 Notes carry a 4.625% annual interest rate, maturing on July 15, 2017, while the 2022 Notes have a 5.875% rate, maturing on July 15, 2022. Interest is paid semi-annually. The Indentures include covenants limiting the Company’s ability to incur debt, pay dividends, make investments, and engage in certain transactions. Notes may be redeemed at a price equal to the principal plus accrued interest and a make-whole premium.
